entities.summary: Precioso Dacalos Cantillas, SDB, D.D. is a Filipino prelate of the Catholic Church who has been serving as the bishop of the Diocese of Maasin since 1998. Prior to that, he was an auxiliary bishop of Cebu from 1995 to 1998. He is a member of the Salesians of Don Bosco. Precioso Cantillas was a religious figures (b. 1953-07-03).
